findings.title: A dispatch against an unmerged branch decides for itself whether EQL publishes and what it publishes
findings.label: valid
findings.note: New workflow_dispatch plus classify treating any non-main chore(release) HEAD as prerelease, with arming read from the dispatched ref and no environment protection, lets unreviewed branches cut releases/tags (and publish after cutover).

findings.title: First armed run publishes npm first, then other artefacts may never follow, or the crate ships alone
findings.label: match
findings.note: Describes the irreversible npm publish preceding eql-sql/docs/image so a downstream failure leaves the npm package without matching SQL/docs/image artefacts (lockstep broken).

findings.title: SQL on the GitHub release and in the image is rebuilt from source rather than taken from the npm tarball
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same rebuild-vs-committed-bytes divergence as F-11, supported by _build-eql-sql.yml:87 and AGENTS.md.
